Marathon Training Skill Progression Plan

Overview
This plan outlines a six-month progression for transitioning from regular workouts to marathon readiness. The focus is on gradually increasing running distance, optimizing nutrition, and integrating strength and flexibility training.

Month 1: Foundation and Base Building
Goal: Establish a consistent running routine and assess current physical baseline.
Milestones:
- Run 3 times per week, focusing on easy-paced jogging.
- Complete a 5K run at a comfortable pace by the end of the month.
- Begin a basic strength training routine (2 times per week) focusing on core and legs.
- Evaluate current diet and identify areas for improvement (e.g., hydration, protein intake).
Timeline: Weeks 1-4

Month 2: Increasing Volume and Strength
Goal: Increase weekly mileage by 10-15% and introduce more structured strength training.
Milestones:
- Increase running frequency to 4 times per week.
- Long run distance reaches 8-10K.
- Incorporate dynamic stretching before runs and static stretching after.
- Add bodyweight exercises (squats, lunges, planks) to strength routine.
- Adjust diet to include more complex carbohydrates for energy.
Timeline: Weeks 5-8

Month 3: Endurance Development
Goal: Build aerobic endurance and improve running efficiency.
Milestones:
- Maintain 4-5 running sessions per week.
- Long run distance reaches 12-14K.
- Introduce one tempo run per week to improve lactate threshold.
- Strength training includes light weights or resistance bands for lower body stability.
- Monitor weight and energy levels to ensure adequate caloric intake.
Timeline: Weeks 9-12

Month 4: Peak Distance Training
Goal: Simulate marathon distances and refine pacing strategies.
Milestones:
- Run 5 times per week, including one long run.
- Long run distance reaches 18-20K.
- Practice nutrition during long runs (gels, sports drinks).
- Strength training focuses on injury prevention (glutes, hips, ankles).
- Incorporate flexibility training (yoga or dedicated stretching) twice a week.
Timeline: Weeks 13-16
